subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Science has been trying innumerable methods to prove the existence of the universe, but the biggest **__pleasure__ **of science is its inability to produce a single theory that explains the whole universe.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Blandness**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pleasure **means a feeling of enjoyment or satisfaction. (**प्रसन्नता**)

 
 
• **Example**: *The music brought her great pleasure.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Blandness **means monotonous & lacking excitement. **(नीरसता)**
 
 
• **Example**: *The dish's blandness failed to excite our taste buds.*
 
 
 
• So, in this context, "Blandness" is the most appropriate antonym for "Pleasure."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inadequacy**: A lack of competence or sufficiency. (**अनुविता**)
 
• **Joy**: A feeling of great happiness or delight. (**आनंद**)
 
• **Fear**: An unpleasant emotion caused by the belief that someone or something is dangerous. (**आशंका**)
